title: Vortex extension info.json
description: The info.json file at the top level of a Vortex extension. The schema describes shape only: types, required keys and structure. Rules about values are written in each field's description. Vortex checks them and falls back to its legacy behaviour when `contributes` breaks one. Unknown keys are allowed everywhere.

$schema.description: Points editors at this schema for completion and field docs. Vortex ignores it.

version.description: Version of the extension, as a semver string such as `1.2.0`.

author.description: Display name of the extension's author. Shown as `<unknown>` when missing.

description.description: Short description of what the extension does. Shown as `<missing>` when missing.

id.description: Stable identifier for the extension, used when other extensions require it with `requireExtension`. Pick one and keep it across versions.

namespace.description: i18next namespace for the extension's translations.

gameId.description: Deprecated: use `contributes.games` instead. Vortex doesn't read it, but the Nexus Mods data platform still does. A number or a string of digits is the Nexus Mods game id (`2304`). Any other string without whitespace is the game's domain on Nexus Mods (`skyrimspecialedition`). Anything else is ignored.

contributes.description: What the extension contributes, readable without running it. Every field is optional. Vortex reads it only when it is valid. One invalid field makes all of `contributes` invalid, and the extension then loads as if it had none, with a warning. Older Vortex versions ignore this key.

games.description: The games the extension registers, keyed by the id it passes to `registerGame`. Keys must be non-empty and must not start with `tier-0-`, which is reserved. Registering an id that isn't listed is an error. An empty object for a game declares the game and nothing else.

gameEnhancements.description: Games the extension is relevant to without registering them, for example a tool or a mod type that works with several games. Advisory.

nexusGameId.description: The Nexus Mods game this game's mods are published on. Must be a positive integer, and `null` isn't allowed. Leave it out when the game has no page on Nexus Mods. Several games may declare the same one: Skyrim Special Edition and Skyrim VR both publish on 1704.

gameUid.description: The game's id in the Nexus Mods game catalogue, found on NexusDB (https://nexusdb.nexusmods.com). Must be non-empty. Required when the game isn't the one its `nexusGameId` belongs to (Skyrim VR on 1704), or when it isn't on Nexus Mods. Any case is accepted, Vortex lowercases it.

name.description: Name for listings that can't run the extension. Must be non-empty. Vortex itself shows the name passed to `registerGame`.

gameEnhancement.description: Sets exactly one of `gameUid` and `nexusGameId`. Setting both, or neither, makes `contributes` invalid.

gameUid.description: Enhances exactly this game. Same rules as `gameUid` on a game.

nexusGameId.description: Enhances every game whose mods are published on this Nexus Mods game. Same rules as `nexusGameId` on a game.
